summary: Tested 6 bug fixes for personal finance app. Fixed 2 critical issues (Issue 1: Linked expense navigation, Issue 4: Profession field). Issue 1 root cause: /api/expenses/list/summary endpoint missing linkedLoanId/linkedInsuranceId/linkedInvestmentId fields. Issue 4 root cause: backend Income model missing 'profession' field.

Issue 1 (P0) - Linked expense navigation.details: EMI->Loan, Insurance->Insurance, SIP->Investment navigation now works
Issue 1 (P0) - Linked expense navigation.root_cause: Backend /api/expenses/list/summary endpoint projection did not include linkedLoanId, linkedInsuranceId, linkedInvestmentId fields
Issue 1 (P0) - Linked expense navigation.fix_applied: Added linked* fields to projection in server.py line 2602-2612

Issue 2 (P0) - Expense summary box click.details: View All -> /expense-breakdown, Category -> /expenses/{category} both work correctly

Issue 4 (P1) - Self-Employed profession.details: Profession field now displays saved value when editing
Issue 4 (P1) - Self-Employed profession.root_cause: Backend Income model and IncomeSourceCreate model did not have 'profession' field
Issue 4 (P1) - Self-Employed profession.fix_applied: Added 'profession: Optional[str] = None' to both Income and IncomeSourceCreate models in server.py

Issue 5 (P1) - Interest Income start/end.details: Start/End date fields show placeholders. This may be expected if no dates were saved for the tested entries. The isInitialLoad flag fix is in place. Need to test with entry that has dates saved.

Task 2 (P2) - Job Income Edit Transactio.details: Transaction History panel exists with Edit button capability. Cannot fully test without existing transactions. The feature code is in place.

action_items: Issue 5: Verify Interest Income date fields by creating an entry with start/end dates and editing it
Task 2: Add a transaction to Job Income and verify Edit button appears and works
updated_files: /app/backend/server.py - Added linkedLoanId, linkedInsuranceId, linkedInvestmentId to /api/expenses/list/summary projection
/app/backend/server.py - Added 'profession' field to Income and IncomeSourceCreate models
seed_data_creation: Updated City Hospital self-employed income with profession='Doctor' for testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Issue 1, 2, 3, 4 verified working. Issue 5 needs verification with data that has start/end dates saved. Task 2 needs verification with transaction data.

Issue 1.problem: Clicking on linked expense (EMI/Insurance/SIP) navigated to expense edit page instead of parent entity page
Issue 1.root_cause: The /api/expenses/list/summary endpoint used by MyExpenses.js and CategoryExpenses.js did not include linkedLoanId, linkedInsuranceId, linkedInvestmentId in its MongoDB projection, so these fields were always null/undefined in frontend
Issue 1.fix: Added the three linked fields to the projection object in /api/expenses/list/summary endpoint

Issue 4.problem: Self-Employed Income profession field showed 'Select Profession' placeholder instead of saved value when editing
Issue 4.root_cause: Backend Income model and IncomeSourceCreate Pydantic model did not have a 'profession' field, so the frontend's profession value was being silently dropped during save/update
Issue 4.fix: Added 'profession: Optional[str] = None' to both Income and IncomeSourceCreate models
